name: Manifestation
description: Rematerialises on any free tile on the map that borders an enemy, leaving adjacent enemies silenced and dealing %dmg_reduction:pct%% less damage for %duration% turns.

upgrade.summary: Leaves a shadow behind for %shadow_duration% turns, which can call this unit back.
details: A shadow is left standing on the tile this unit vanished from, with its statline and the health it left with.
The shadow cannot move, and lasts %shadow_duration% turns. Its Recall pulls this unit back to wherever the shadow is standing, and the shadow with it.
Anything that shifts the shadow shifts where the recall lands - a translocated shadow is a translocated escape route.
